summary.text: Glenn Nocera is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate challenging incumbent Robert C. Carroll in Assembly District 44.
He ran for this seat once before, in 2016, and lost to Carroll; he has not held elected office.
A 2016 news report described him as a Kensington resident and Brooklyn College alumnus who led the Brooklyn Young Republican Club.

paragraphs.text: A 2016 news report described Nocera as hailing from Kensington and working as a campus security officer at Brooklyn College, where he is also an alumnus and where he started and led the Brooklyn College Young Republican Club.
He was president of the borough-wide Brooklyn Young Republican Club from 2011 to 2015 and its board chairman as of 2016.
The same report said he had held other Republican posts in Brooklyn, including district leader, and was president of the Brooklyn Tea Party.
In 2016 Nocera ran for the open 44th Assembly District seat as the Republican and Conservative candidate, after running unopposed in the Republican primary.
He lost the general election to Robert C. Carroll, 14.55% to 85.45%.
